cases.title: Settings shows the account: email, password change round-trip, sign out

consent -> loopback code -> redeem -> save 201 -> deep link -> revoke -> 401
the CLI delivers a set once, however its save is interrupted, repeated or doubled

analytics remains empty until acceptance and withdrawal erases local and server history
declining sends nothing and the phone prompt stays fully reachable
Global Privacy Control overrides the prompt and any collection
creates a graphic and reaches export with no account

the AI door offers a free account, not just a sign-in
account features prompt for sign-in instead of walling the app
an expiry notification leaves anonymous creation usable and sign-in stays explicit
signed out, the save dialog says the graphic stays on this computer
signed out, Start production says it needs an account and offers sign-in right there
signed out, a control-panel link offers a sign-in that actually opens
a dead reset link says so, and offers a new one
a reset link that predates the route still opens the recovery page

a press another screen overtook is refused, writes nothing, and the operator is told
a Take held on its way arrives after the Out, is left out, and never airs
a press of several batches never undoes a later press, and nothing pressed before All out airs after it

the server refuses a direct publish and a community-assets upload
an admin submits a folder, approves it, a visitor installs it, and Take down removes it
a maker updates a live pack: the update waits beside it, approval replaces it, and Install gives the new one
Home: a folder and a selection open the submit sheet with their own graphics chosen
the server takes a submit from an account that is not an admin for review only, and refuses one with community.publish off
a chat client signs in through the consent page, is served as a connector, and is stopped by Revoke
a deployment whose Auth runs no OAuth server answers 503 connector_disabled on every connector path
a chat client signs in with PKCE and its token reaches no table, function or object directly
a chat client sends one package that installs into a working, branded production; refusals store nothing; a recipe pack imports

a control link moves bound values and cannot delete, truncate or blank the data
a suspended account cannot rename its team, rotate its code or file a report
a published quiz and scoreboard run across the dashboard and two hosted tabs, through a reload of each
a signed-out deep link keeps its address @production
a signed-out production link asks for a sign-in rather than calling it gone @production
a production link opens once signed in from it, and an absent one names only the account
a graphic saved elsewhere opens on its link, however slow the pull
a sync asked for during a pass waits for one that can see the new data
an absent production is answered by its completed pass while unrelated writes remain pending
a note reaches the endpoint, and carries nothing it should not
a positive rating asks nothing further
the dialog closes without sending anything
Home has its own door, and it reports Home
the sheet wears the shared header shape
a production whose live connection never joins says so, and a healthy one does not
avatar menu routes to Home and opens settings; sign out returns the Sign in button
a published profile arranges and moves the shared value on the hosted page
a fresh operator page boots, takes its first cue, and holds it on air
a hosted tab reloaded mid-quiz reveals on air exactly the verdict it shows
the hosted page carries both SPACE modes: the cursor previews nothing, SPACE stages, SPACE airs, SPACE cuts back
an imported quiz board publishes, runs on the real output renderer, and repaints its drawn states after a reboot
a Take that commits after its page gave up takes the "on this monitor only" notice down
a held Take is abandoned inside the window and never reaches air, even behind a later Out
Home says the library is on its way, not that nothing is saved
an output says who it is and how commands reach it, and both operator pages show one health line
the readiness run publishes what changed, checks every output and ends in a stamp both surfaces show
an output stays listed on the hosted health line through 90 s of a busy show
READY: every output says whether it is ready, both surfaces read one line, a broken graphic is named and a dead output is red
an operator page waits out a database outage instead of calling the production unpublished
a cue taken before the renderer exists is on air when the browser source boots
a renderer whose realtime channel never joins still airs a take, and says it is polling
an output URL can render the show and cannot push a command onto it
a reload keeps the panel, a second production page never takes it, and takes over once the first is gone
a hosted page pairs a panel, answers it, runs its presses and refuses repeated and stale ones
the production page pairs a panel, answers it, runs its presses and refuses repeated and stale ones
the clip clock a panel counts follows the server clip the production page plays
a one-time code pairs a panel once, and the page lists it
with no answering page a press is refused and nothing is relayed
a press reaches the answering page stamped with its claim, with only the permitted fields
the relay refuses foreign verbs, malformed presses, wrong keys and bursts
the panel lease: taken when free, never taken from a live page, kept on reload, moved by Use here, renewed, and lapsing
two pages taking a free panel at once: exactly one gets it
revoking a panel stops it at once, moves the feedback topic, and leaves the others working
feedback travels page to panels on its topic; nobody but the database writes the press topic
two outputs each swap a changed graphic in place, and hold one on air until it is cleared
one press is one entrance on the sender, on another operator, and on air
the playout status: quiet until something reports, green when it does, red only for loss or a fault, and Publish changes moves the outputs
the pro-status route is REACHED and answers the wire contract
a configured backend does not reopen the closed wizard door
a published production shows its data key, and that key writes the production data
unpublishing and publishing again keeps every capability URL
a newer design on air stops the publish, and a publish landing in between is published over once
a teammate's older copy never replaces the newer design, and their cue and layer still publish
the CasparCG default is stored by Auth, starts a new production switched on in another browser, and clearing it leaves existing productions alone
a published quiz runs the sealed sequence on the real output renderer, and survives a renderer reboot mid-lock
an exported graphic loaded after the take airs it, from the real log
a timed cue counts the same second on two pages and a reload, ends once, holds from a phone, and stays missed
a published scorebug takes a score bump and a running clock on the real output renderer
two students take turns on one browser and neither sees nor loses the work of the other
